layout: per clip at `offset`: frames x 22 x int16 [x,y,z,w]*32767 local rotations (SMPL-X joints 0..21, root = global orientation, +Y up, faces +Z), then frames x float32 [x,y,z] root offset (source metres; x/z in place)
source: HY-Motion 1.0 (tencent/HY-Motion-1.0 @620dd559, code @4e426f5a), text guidance 5.0, 50 Euler steps, 30 fps; seamless loops by worker/motion_library.py

clips.name: idle-listen
clips.prompt: A person stands still, listening to someone, nodding slightly now and then, with relaxed arms and a small shift of weight between the feet.

clips.name: talk-1
clips.prompt: A person stands in place talking to someone, gesturing naturally with both hands in front of the body as they explain something.

clips.name: talk-2
clips.prompt: A person stands and talks to someone in front of them, now and then opening both palms outward as if asking a question, then lowering the hands.

clips.name: sit-idle
clips.prompt: A person sits on a chair, relaxed, hands resting on the thighs, looking around calmly.

clips.name: sit-talk
clips.prompt: A person sits upright on a chair and talks to someone, moving both hands in front of the chest as they speak.

clips.name: walk
clips.prompt: A person walks forward in a straight line at a relaxed, normal pace.
